summary: AAP 2.6 uses pluggable authentication with a wizard and allows multiple authenticators of the same type; authenticator plugins connect to sources such as LDAP or SAML. Logging out of AAP does not end your SSO provider session.
questions: Can I configure two LDAP authenticators in AAP?
Why am I logged back in with the same SSO account?
What is an authenticator plugin in AAP?
